title: How to Build a Social App With AI (No Developer Required)
summary: Build a social app with AI — user profiles, posts, follows, DMs, and moderation. Database, auth, and hosting included. No developer needed.
body_markdown: Blink's included hosting and database handle scaling without manual infrastructure changes. The database is provisioned to support growth on paid plans. For very high-traffic apps (100K+ active users), you would work with Blink's team on infrastructure scaling — but for a niche community reaching its first 10,000 members, no changes are needed. Most niche social apps take 12–18 months to reach 10,000 active members.
